scenarios.name: value-above-gate
scenarios.note: Value 25000 vs floor 10000: C# keep; JS picks up. Agree.

scenarios.name: value-exact-boundary
scenarios.note: Value exactly at the floor: C# >= keeps; JS `value < minValue` skip-test also keeps. Agree at the boundary.

scenarios.name: value-below-gate
scenarios.note: Value 500 vs floor 10000: both leave it.

scenarios.name: value-missing-prop
scenarios.note: No Value(19) at all (unappraised/unstreamed): C# Values(19,0)=0 -> no-loot; JS `?? 0` -> skip. Same fail-closed direction — but see the appraisal-gate finding in the README (C# waits for appraisal upstream, JS never does).

scenarios.name: value-zero-gate-zero

scenarios.note: Rule with zero conditions matches everything (VTankLootEvaluator.cs:143); JS minValue=0 also picks up everything. Agree.
